render_policy: Reference all named characters by ID; never overwrite identity fields from an episode script. Require approved visual refs and approved voice sample before rendering production.

characters.name: Noah
characters.visual: 12-year-old boy, warm medium-brown skin, short curly black hair, dark brown eyes; cobalt-blue hooded jacket with one white lightning-shaped seam on left sleeve; charcoal trousers; worn white trainers; slender short build.
never_change: cobalt jacket, white zigzag sleeve seam on LEFT arm
characters.arc: stops chasing perfect tomorrows and chooses living truthfully

voice.voice_direction: energetic and uncertain; youthful presentation without trying to mimic a real child
voice.delivery: short breaths, quick words when afraid; audition for believable youthful timbre
voice.audition: I remember tomorrow. So why does nobody remember yesterday?

characters.name: Mira
characters.visual: 13-year-old girl, medium-olive skin, shoulder-length dark auburn wavy hair tied with one copper clip on right side, hazel eyes, mustard-yellow raincoat over lavender hoodie, small navy canvas satchel.
characters.personality: witty, bold, often forgotten by the city
characters.arc: recovers evidence of her erased existence

voice.voice_direction: bright, witty and alert with sudden vulnerability
voice.delivery: fast sarcastic remarks; slow down for fear and care
voice.audition: You don’t remember me. But I’ve saved your life three times.

characters.name: Dr. Vale
characters.role: scientist and keeper of the clock records
characters.visual: Middle-aged woman with deep-brown skin, salt-and-pepper hair in tight low bun, oval silver glasses, emerald waistcoat over ivory shirt, ink-stained fingers, calm serious expression.
characters.personality: brilliant, guilty, committed to fixing harm she helped cause
characters.arc: admits she designed memory safeguard and helps disable it

voice.voice_direction: calm, analytical, composed, with tension under restraint
voice.delivery: precise emphasis on clock rules and difficult admissions
voice.audition: The clock does not control time. It controls what the city remembers.

characters.name: The Clockkeeper
characters.visual: Tall slim man of ambiguous age, pale tan skin, dark straight hair with silver streak on left temple, brass-rimmed round spectacles, long faded golden-yellow coat, black gloves, pocket watch engraved with twelve small stars.
characters.personality: evasive and protective; believes forgetting prevents catastrophe
characters.arc: abandons his controlling methods and allows the truth out

voice.voice_direction: controlled, low and mysterious; ultimately humane
voice.delivery: precise, unhurried, emotionally remote until finale
voice.audition: Some tomorrows are too dangerous to remember.

voice.voice_direction: slightly mysterious, warm, measured British male narrator
voice.audition: At exactly midnight, the city forgot a name.
